items.context:
The integrated HYDROHANDS technology uses special calibrated jets to create a spiralling, therapeutic motion in the water – for a new type of massage. This dynamic, multidimensional whirlpool effect reaches and relaxes even deep muscle groups, allowing for a full back massage similar to ones done by hand.

This technology combines with the ZERO DIMENSION technology in our Flotation Tub. The ideal reclining position paired with the deep, comforting back massage from HYDROHANDS guarantees maximum relaxation.
